name: Contagion
description:
You draw forth infectious spores from your Symbiotes and transmit them to a creature you touch. Roll Spirit vs. Fortitude against the creature. On a win, your roll result becomes this spell’s Difficulty, then choose one of the following diseases:

  • Blinding Sickness. The creature’s eyes swell shut and it becomes blinded.

  • Fever. A raging fever wracks the creature. Its Strength rolls are ill-favored and its Defense is reduced by your HEART score.

  • Seizure. The creature is overcome with violent shaking. It falls prone and automatically fails/loses all Dexterity rolls.

  • Flesh Rot. The creature’s flesh decays. Its Awe, Perform, Courtesy, and Persuade rolls are ill-favored.

  • Delusion. The creature’s mind clouds. Its Insight, Awareness, Lore, and Riddle rolls are ill-favored.

The disease lasts up to 7 days. At the end of each day, the affected creature rolls Fortitude against the spell’s Difficulty. On a pass, the disease ends.

Whenever an infected creature touches another creature, that creature must roll Fortitude against the spell’s Difficulty. On a failure, it contracts the same disease.

Each time any creature successfully ends the disease, reduce the spell’s Difficulty by 1.

Describe the effects of the disease.
successes:
✨: If the first infected creature contracts the disease, its subsequent rolls to end the disease are ill-favored.

🌞: Choose a second disease. That disease is inflicted and transmitted along with the first.
